verdict.rationale: The API is visibly versioned: the endpoints and public OpenAPI document sit under /api/v3/, which implies a versioning scheme with at least prior major versions. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, deprecation headers, or changelog commitments, so only half the story is shown, and only by implication from the URL path. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, an explicit versioning policy statement, a changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration of version stability.
